themes_detail.label: Mobile Food Vendor Surge
themes_detail.summary: Mobile food vendor complaints spiked to 12 this week, a 465% increase vs. the 2.1 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, suggesting either a sudden influx of unlicensed vendors or concentrated enforcement activity on the Upper East Side.
evidence: 12 mobile food vendor complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (465% spike, z-score: 5.03)
No sustained pattern prior to this week; represents a sharp, isolated acceleration
Complaints cite vendor enforcement category, suggesting either street-level proliferation or targeted DOE compliance checks
reporting_angles: Are unlicensed street vendors concentrating in specific UES neighborhoods or transit hubs? Interview residents and business owners.
Is the spike driven by new enforcement or by seasonal vendor activity? Check with Dept. of Health & Mental Hygiene and vendor licensing agencies.

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints in parks skyrocketed to 3 last week, a 2300% spike vs. the 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks, indicating a sudden and severe disturbance event or pattern shift in Upper East Side park usage.
evidence: 3 park noise complaints last week vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% increase, z-score: 8.69, highest statistical severity)
Baseline was near-zero, making even small absolute numbers a dramatic departure
Likely concentrated in major UES parks (Central Park, Madison Square Park, or smaller neighborhood green spaces)
reporting_angles: Which specific park(s) generated the complaints? Was there a concert, event, construction, or ongoing disturbance?
Interview Parks Dept. and nearby residents about causes and whether issues persist into this week.

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs & Public Safety
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints jumped to 4 last week, a 967% increase vs. the 0.4 weekly average over 8 weeks, signaling a possible enforcement gap or emerging off-leash culture in neighborhood parks.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (967% spike, z-score: 7.49)
Spike occurs alongside park noise complaints, suggesting possible overlap (dog parks or parks with heavy dog traffic)
High z-score indicates statistical rarity and significance
reporting_angles: Are specific parks (especially dog parks or Central Park areas) the hotspot? Survey dog owners and parents about safety concerns.
Interview Parks Enforcement and NYPD about off-leash enforcement trends and resource allocation.

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Disposal Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints nearly quintupled to 16 last week, a 392% increase vs. the 3.2 weekly average over 8 weeks, raising questions about sanitation infrastructure and public health monitoring in the district.
evidence: 16 dead animal complaints last week vs. 3.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (392% increase, z-score: 5.23)
Elevated complaint count suggests either increased mortality events (wildlife die-off, seasonal migration) or slower removal response by Sanitation
Converges with other sanitation-related spikes (dumpster complaints, unsanitary conditions)
reporting_angles: Is this seasonal (migratory bird death, rat population spike) or tied to specific locations? Map complaint geographically.
How long is the typical response time for dead animal removal? Interview DSNY and test their service responsiveness.

themes_detail.label: Street-Level Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints rose to 43 last week, a 102% increase vs. the 21.2 weekly average over 8 weeks, suggesting sustained elevation in construction, commercial activity, or street vending that warrants neighborhood mapping.
evidence: 43 street/sidewalk noise complaints last week vs. 21.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (102% increase, z-score: 5.45)
Doubling of baseline suggests either new construction projects, expanded commercial activity, or vendor/traffic concentration
Aligns with elevated mobile food vendor complaints and building alteration permit surge (1818 alteration permits filed in 90 days)
reporting_angles: Map where street noise complaints cluster—are they tied to specific construction sites or commercial corridors (Madison Ave., Park Ave., Lexington)?
Cross-reference against DOB alteration permits to see if street noise correlates with ongoing renovation work.
